title: Connector Registry admin contract
purpose: Promote frame 01 into a bounded future Integrations admin state.
scope_boundary: Admin-only connector registry dossier and health/status presentation; no real adapter execution, external API calls, or dependency activation.
entry_condition: TASK-009 snapshot/export is complete and the Filter Preset first-slice evidence remains the baseline.
exit_condition: Connector Registry implementation tasks and visual tests are defined with explicit runtime adapter deferral.
allowed_expansion: Define connector card data shape for admin display.
Define connector status, dependency policy, and compatibility badges.
Define preview modal copy and visual QA requirements.
forbidden_expansion: Execute WooCommerce, JetEngine, Elementor Pro, ACF, or Meta Box adapters.
Add external service calls or runtime dependency probing beyond documented admin mock state.
tasks: Define connector categories: listing provider, filter source, budget action, commerce adapter, editor helper, QA capture.
Define admin-only health and compatibility inspector sections.
Define visual QA for connector cards, badges, and inspector containment.
